title: Discovery of Pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyridazinone Derivatives as Selective DDR1 Inhibitors via Deep Learning Based Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation.
summary: Model-based scaffold design yielded a new selective DDR1 inhibitor tested biochemically, in cells and in a mouse colitis model.
organization: Chinese Academy of Sciences; Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica; State Key Laboratory of Drug Research

evidence.tested: Model-based scaffold design yielded a new selective DDR1 inhibitor tested biochemically, in cells and in a mouse colitis model.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Deep generative molecular model is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
